review_kind: AI-assisted source-context review of pipeline annotation handoffs, external image and mask import routes, and parasite assay pathway titles. Seven shared phrases match the generated workflow tutorial banks. No native-speaker sign-off.

records.key: Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.source: Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.translation: 在实际特征列或坐标列上定义阈值门控或多边形门控，然后将保存的门控规则应用于兼容对象。使用 Annotate 将显示的门控结果写入注释列；检查所选对象，并选择二分类或多分类标签。

records.key: For image-only imports, use Import Images or Format Converter and point Mask at the formatted image project. External measurements alone are not segmentation input.
records.source: For image-only imports, use Import Images or Format Converter and point Mask at the formatted image project. External measurements alone are not segmentation input.
records.translation: 仅导入图像时，使用 Import Images 或 Format Converter，并将 Mask 指向格式化后的图像项目。仅有外部测量数据不能作为分割输入。

records.key: Import external measurements with explicit object/column mappings, or choose Import Images, Format Converter or External Masks. Imported measurements are not a fresh Measure run. With matching source images and external integer masks, Import builds the merged project arrays used by Measure. Choose the route matching your files and inspect object identities before measuring; imported feature tables can be used directly when they already contain the required measurements.
records.source: Import external measurements with explicit object/column mappings, or choose Import Images, Format Converter or External Masks. Imported measurements are not a fresh Measure run. With matching source images and external integer masks, Import builds the merged project arrays used by Measure. Choose the route matching your files and inspect object identities before measuring; imported feature tables can be used directly when they already contain the required measurements.
records.translation: 通过明确的对象和列映射导入外部测量数据，或选择 Import Images、Format Converter 或 External Masks。导入测量数据不等于重新运行 Measure。有匹配的源图像和外部整数掩膜时，Import 会构建供 Measure 使用的合并项目数组。选择与文件相符的路径，并在测量前检查对象身份；若导入的特征表已包含所需测量值，则可直接使用。

records.key: Import matching images and external integer masks to build merged project arrays, then open Measure on that project. Skip this step when compatible measurements have already been imported or computed. Do not append duplicate measurements to an existing imported table.
records.source: Import matching images and external integer masks to build merged project arrays, then open Measure on that project. Skip this step when compatible measurements have already been imported or computed. Do not append duplicate measurements to an existing imported table.
records.translation: 导入匹配的图像和外部整数掩膜以构建合并项目数组，然后在该项目中打开 Measure。若已导入或计算兼容的测量值，则跳过此步骤。不要向已有的导入表追加重复测量。

records.key: Project measured features or supplied encoder features and inspect representative crops. A cluster is a candidate grouping, not a validated phenotype. Use the lasso and annotation controls to write reviewed selections to an annotation column in the matching measurement database. A geometric selection alone does not establish a biological phenotype.
records.source: Project measured features or supplied encoder features and inspect representative crops. A cluster is a candidate grouping, not a validated phenotype. Use the lasso and annotation controls to write reviewed selections to an annotation column in the matching measurement database. A geometric selection alone does not establish a biological phenotype.
records.translation: 对实测特征或提供的编码器特征进行投影，并检查有代表性的裁剪图像。聚类只是候选分组，并非已验证的表型。使用套索和注释控件，将审查后的选择写入对应测量数据库的注释列。单靠几何选择不能确立生物学表型。

records.key: Write reviewed gate selections to an annotation column, then select that same column and object population in Classify. Keep validation objects separate from training labels.
records.source: Write reviewed gate selections to an annotation column, then select that same column and object population in Classify. Keep validation objects separate from training labels.
records.translation: 将审查后的门控选择写入注释列，然后在 Classify 中选择同一列和同一对象群体。验证对象必须与训练标签分开。

records.key: Write reviewed lasso selections to an annotation column in the matching object database, then select that column in Classify. Inspect crops and validate labels; embedding clusters are not ground truth.
records.source: Write reviewed lasso selections to an annotation column in the matching object database, then select that column in Classify. Inspect crops and validate labels; embedding clusters are not ground truth.
records.translation: 将审查后的套索选择写入对应对象数据库的注释列，然后在 Classify 中选择该列。检查裁剪图像并验证标签；嵌入空间中的聚类并非真实参考标签。
